claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage.saveSourceFilter
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The robe needs saving-throw advantage that applies only when the save is caused by a spell or other magical effect. The existing surface can narrow by save ability, but not by the source/cause of the saving throw.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
